units.source_text: 这期间源氏公子常常想起那个空蝉：

en.t: During this time, Prince Genji often thought of that woman Utsusemi:

units.source_text: “那天晚上灯下对弈时所窥见的侧影，实在并不漂亮。

en.t: The profile I glimpsed that night as she played go under the lamplight was really not beautiful.

units.source_text: 然而她那窈窕的体态隐藏了她的丑处，使人不觉得难看。

en.t: Yet her graceful, slender figure concealed her plainness, so that one did not find her unattractive.

units.source_text: 这位小姐呢，讲到身份，并不亚于空蝉。

en.t: As for this young lady, in terms of rank she is by no means inferior to Utsusemi.

units.source_text: 可见女子的优劣，和家世是无关的。

en.t: It seems, then, that a woman’s worth has nothing to do with family background.

units.source_text: 空蝉顽强固执，令人可恨，我终于让步了。”

en.t: Utsusemi was so stubborn and unyielding that she made me resentful, and in the end I gave way.
